title: Illinois Wesleyan women's volleyball secures share of CCIW regular season title
text:
Illinois Wesleyan women’s volleyball secures share of CCIW regular season title
The Illinois Wesleyan University women's volleyball team clinched a share of its third straight conference championship after sweeping Carthage College at home. Seniors Cailin Shannon and Eleanor Palmer powered IWU’s offense as they remain undefeated in league play.
The Illinois Wesleyan University women's volleyball team claimed a share of the College Conference of Illinois and Wisconsin Regular Season Championship after defeating Carthage College in straight sets on Oct. 21 in Bloomington, Illinois. The win marks the program's third consecutive regular season conference title, advancing the Titans to 7-0 in conference play and 21-1 overall.
Seniors Cailin Shannon and Eleanor Palmer led the Titans' offense. Shannon recorded 15 kills with a .560 hitting percentage and four digs, while Palmer contributed 10 kills on 12 swings for a .667 attacking percentage. Junior Alex Bardouniotis added nine kills, with Graci Junis, Carly Whitaker, and Juliana Valdez each adding five kills. Senior Sophia Feeney distributed 23 assists, and sophomore Lauren O'Brien added 17 more.
Defensively, junior Alysa Lawton tallied 18 digs along with six assists. Bardouniotis reached double digits in digs with ten, followed by Feeney with nine. Valdez led the team in blocks with two rejections.
The Titans established an early lead in the first set through key plays from Junis and Bardouniotis before closing out their most dominant set win of the year at 25-7. In the second set, Carthage held an early advantage before IWU tied it at eight points apiece. A series of strong plays from Valdez and O'Brien pushed IWU ahead as they secured a second-set victory at 25-19 following a kill from Shannon.
In the final set, contributions from Junis and Shannon helped build momentum for IWU as they pulled away to clinch match point at 24-17 before ultimately winning on an error by Carthage for another set score of 25-19.
Illinois Wesleyan will conclude its regular season conference play next week against North Central College in Naperville, Illinois. The women's volleyball team belongs to the College Conference of Illinois and Wisconsin; home games are played on campus in Bloomington under their green-and-white Titans nickname. According to the official website, Illinois Wesleyan has previously won NCAA Division III national championships in both 2007 and 2010.
